probes_methods.probe1: Resolver frozen tree: parse npm package-lock.json packages map with node_modules walk-up resolution, plus uv.lock [[package]] edges. Live lockfiles outside p2-wave probe scratch are the population.
probes_methods.probe2: Independently built graph from installed package metadata in an isolated fixture environment: dist-info METADATA Requires-Dist and node_modules package.json dependencies. Does not read lockfiles to build that graph. Host site-packages are not the repo closure.

report.question: What is the full transitive dependency closure across ecosystems, what is its maximum depth, and which packages appear at two or more incompatible versions in the same closure?

upstream_directs.note: Probe tables are the catalog input 'direct dependency tables'. They are not a resolved transitive closure. Official AUD-0020/AUD-0021 output_path artifacts are recorded present/absent separately. Retrying a missing official artifact as if it were the closure would be a detector failure.
